info.name: DA-CARAGA PMIS API
info.description:
Complete API collection for Department of Agriculture - CARAGA Region Performance Management Information System (PMIS)

**Authentication:** Laravel Sanctum (Token-based)
**Updated:** 2026-01-28 (Migrated from Passport to Sanctum)

**Default Login:**
- Username: admin
- Password: Password123!

**Base URL:** http://localhost:8000/api

**How to Use:**
1. Send a POST request to `/api/login` with your credentials
2. The token will be automatically saved to `{{access_token}}` variable
3. All authenticated requests will use this token automatically via Bearer authentication
4. Use `/api/logout` to invalidate your current token

**Note:** All authenticated endpoints require a valid Bearer token in the Authorization header.
